You are making one targeted prompt change in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no model call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: storygame/runtime/item_facts.py and tests/test_observation_prompt.py (append tests; change no existing assertion). Never edit storygame/runtime/observation.py, packages/, data/, docs/, worker/, other modules.

CONTEXT: the opt-in observation prompt (ItemFactsProvider.observation_request) already adds a `Show these in your reply:` CONSTRAINTS line from ObservationContext.required (see _section_user_prompt in storygame/runtime/item_facts.py and tests/test_observation_prompt.py). ObservationContext.scope_complete is True only when the focus entity declares contents_complete (story packages can now declare it; see tests/test_package_view_scope.py for how to build a package copy with `contents_complete: true` on the drawer). It is computed but never rendered, so a searched place that is declared complete and now empty reads the same to the narrator as one never described, and the narrator invents a replacement clue. Only a complete, empty scope licenses an unqualified empty result.

CHANGE: in observation mode only, when context.scope_complete is true AND the focus scope has no known contents (context.visible_things holds nothing located inside the focus entity: no required names and no thing whose containment chain includes the focus), add ONE CONSTRAINTS line in plain 12th-grade words, with the focus entity's public name, exactly: `- The <focus name> holds nothing else the player can find.` Use the world's public name for the focus (world.name), never an id. When scope_complete is false, or anything known remains inside the focus, add nothing. Do not change the `Show these` line, THINGS, or PLAYER handling. No story vocabulary in code.

TESTS FIRST (append to tests/test_observation_prompt.py; hermetic, real package copied to tmp_path with the drawer declared contents_complete as in tests/test_package_view_scope.py): (a) after the memory card is taken (moved to the protagonist) a request ObservationRequest('Search beneath the drawer.', 'look', <drawer id>) yields the CONSTRAINTS line `The drawer holds nothing else the player can find.` (check the drawer's real public name) and the held card appears nowhere under the drawer; (b) the same state on the unmodified shipped package (no declaration) has no such line; (c) with the declaration but an item still inside the drawer's scope, no such line; (d) default off (observation_request None) is unchanged. Run, see them fail, then build. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format both files; report pass counts.
